topStories.summary_en: Brazil is also heading to the polls today for a run-off vote that will decide who leads the country. The race is on a knife edge between incumbent left-wing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, Flávio scored a major upset in the first round earlier this month, taking the lead in the vote.
topStories.summary_zh: 巴西今天也将进行第二轮投票，决定谁领导该国。现任左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦和右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗之间的竞争处于刀锋之上。前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的儿子弗拉维奥在本月早些时候的第一轮选举中大获全胜，在投票中领先。

stories.title_en: Low-dose aspirin linked to 70% lower dementia risk, but there's a catch
stories.title_zh: 低剂量阿司匹林可降低 70% 的痴呆风险，但有一个问题
stories.summary_en: A common, inexpensive medication could hold an unexpected clue to preventing dementia. Researchers found that older adults with a specific genetic profile had a 70% lower relative risk of dementia when taking low-dose aspirin, even though previous studies found no overall protective effect. The discovery suggests that genetics could help explain why some people benefit while others do not.
stories.summary_zh: 一种常见、廉价的药物可能为预防痴呆症提供意想不到的线索。研究人员发现，具有特定基因谱的老年人在服用低剂量阿司匹林时，患痴呆症的相对风险降低了 70%，尽管之前的研究发现没有总体保护作用。这一发现表明，遗传学可以帮助解释为什么有些人受益而另一些人却没有。

stories.summary_en: Millions of years after animals first conquered land, some took an extraordinary evolutionary U-turn and returned to the water. Using machine learning and thousands of fossil measurements, Yale scientists have uncovered surprising clues about which prehistoric creatures truly became aquatic.
